title: MeshGuard — Network Simulator
description: An interactive mesh network simulator that demonstrates shortest-path routing, link and router failures, and automated recovery.
details: Models an eight-router network with weighted links and Dijkstra routing.
Simulates packet delivery and failures with automatic path recomputation.
Visualizes network health, recovery timing, and event logs.

title: MotionForge — Gesture Playground
description: A browser-based hackathon prototype that uses webcam hand tracking to move virtual objects, complete motor-practice missions, and display interaction feedback.
details: Calibrates hand tracking and uses pinch gestures to grab and place objects.
Includes catch, reach, sequence, and transfer games alongside mission-based levels.
Built in the Bug Eaters team hackathon context; presented as an interaction prototype.

title: Aram Yoga Studio
description: A yoga studio website presenting classes, instructors, pricing, and a pose library through a responsive Next.js interface.
details: Presents class schedules, studio amenities, and instructor information.
Includes booking and yoga quiz interfaces.
Organizes pose guidance, pricing, frequently asked questions, and a media gallery.

title: Cloud Image Storage
description: A full-stack image gallery with a React interface, an Express API, and Amazon S3 storage for uploading, viewing, and deleting images.
details: Validates image types and limits uploads to 5 MB.
Lists stored images using temporary signed S3 URLs.
Supports image deletion and displays upload and request feedback.

title: TaskFlow — Cloud To-Do
description: A cloud-connected task dashboard with an AWS API Gateway endpoint and a Cognito sign-in integration.
details: Connects the task interface to a cloud-hosted to-do API.
Displays task and completion counts with request feedback.
Handles sign-in redirects and displays the signed-in user.

title: ShopNow — Product Catalog
description: A React shopping interface with product search, category filters, pagination, and an interactive cart.
details: Combines product-name search with category filtering.
Paginates the catalog with six products per page.
Adds and removes cart items, calculates totals, and displays action notifications.

title: Swiggy Clone & Web UI
description: A React recreation of a food-delivery browsing interface with food categories, restaurant cards, and reusable page components.
details: Composes the page from navigation, hero, category, restaurant-list, and footer components.
Separates restaurant and category content into dedicated data modules.
Available as a public Vercel demo.

title: EMart — Inventory Management
description: An inventory management mini-project with an Oracle database, Flask endpoints, and a Tkinter desktop interface.
details: Adds, lists, and deletes inventory products.
Provides API routes for stock quantities, suppliers, and orders.
Includes a desktop product form and inventory table.

title: Smart Timetable Generator
description: A PHP and MySQL college scheduling project that allocates subjects across a five-day, eight-period timetable.
details: Validates the weekly period total and reserves a mentoring slot.
Prioritizes consecutive lab blocks before allocating theory periods.
Checks available periods, daily subject repetition, and faculty assignments.

title: Python & NLP Coursework
description: A collection of Jupyter exercises covering Python fundamentals, regular expressions, PDF reading, and natural language processing.
details: Explores tokenization and sentence segmentation with spaCy.
Inspects part-of-speech tags and dependency labels.
Includes separate notebooks for regular expressions, PDF reading, and Python basics.

title: Personal Developer Portfolio
description: A Next.js portfolio presenting projects, technical skills, education, and contact information through a responsive interface.
details: Organizes personal information and projects in reusable sections.
Includes résumé download and social profile links.
Provides a contact form with a Supabase integration.
